components.name: button-primary
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; background-color: #1d3c66; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.18); transition: opacity 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; background-color: #2b5286; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a74a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: button-accent-cta
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; background-color: #c8102e; color: #ffffff; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; text-decoration: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background-color: #e03a58; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ee6c83; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: button-outline
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #1d3c66; color: #1d3c66; background: transparent; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: #eef3f9; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a74a8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline.ds-dark { border-color: #7c9fcb; color: #7c9fcb; } .ds-btn-outline.ds-dark:hover { background-color: #061120; }

components.name: card-default
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #dde4ec; background-color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.18); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.08), 0 16px 40px -16px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.28); } .ds-card-inverted { background-color: #0a1a2f; color: #f8fafc; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-article-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #dde4ec; background-color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.18); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-article-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.08), 0 16px 40px -16px rgb(10 26 47 / 0.28); } .ds-article-card-image { overflow: hidden; background-color: #eef2f6; } .ds-article-card-image img { aspect-ratio: 16/9; width: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.5s ease; } .ds-article-card:hover .ds-article-card-image img { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-article-card-body { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-article-card-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', Arial Narrow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; margin-top: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.3; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.005em; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background-color: #eef2f6; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #47566b; } .ds-article-card.ds-featured { flex-direction: row; } @media (max-width: 639px) { .ds-article-card.ds-featured { flex-direction: column; } .ds-article-card.ds-featured .ds-article-card-image { width: 100%; } }

components.name: fixture-item
components.css: .ds-fixture { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-left: 4px solid #7c9fcb; } .ds-fixture-home { border-left-color: #7c9fcb; } .ds-fixture-date { width: 5rem; flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fixture-time { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #47566b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fixture-teams { min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-fixture-divider { margin: 0 0.375rem; color: #47566b; } .ds-fixture-result { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', Arial Narrow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fixture-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 999px; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-fixture-badge.ds-win { background-color: #16a34a; color: #ffffff; } .ds-fixture-badge.ds-loss { background-color: #a60c26; color: #ffffff; } .ds-fixture-badge.ds-draw { background-color: #94a4b8; color: #ffffff; }

components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; border-bottom: 1px solid #dde4ec; background-color: rgb(248 250 252 / 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-container { max-width: 72rem; width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 1rem; display: flex; height: 4rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', Arial Narrow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-nav { display: none; } } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; transition: background-color 0.1s ease, color 0.1s ease; color: #47566b; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background-color: #eef2f6; color: #111827; } .ds-nav-link.ds-active { background-color: #eef2f6; color: #111827; } .ds-theme-toggle { display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; color: #47566b; border: none; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background-color: #eef2f6; color: #111827; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-header { background-color: rgb(6 17 32 / 0.9); border-bottom-color: #142c4c; } .ds-nav-link, .ds-theme-toggle { color: #94a4b8; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background-color: #0f2138; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-nav-link.ds-active { background-color: #0f2138; color: #f8fafc; } }

components.name: input-text
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #dde4ec; background-color: #f8fafc; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #111827; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2b5286; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a4b8; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-input { background-color: #061120; border-color: #142c4c; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4a74a8; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } }

narrative.overview: A Norwegian ice hockey club website that carries the atmosphere of a local arena at night — deep navy stands as the night sky, cold ice-blue surfaces evoke the rink, and one vivid red accent cuts through like the scoreboard glowing in the dark. The design is professional enough to print on a programme, energetic enough to make someone want to put on their skates.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy base with cold ice-blue neutrals
Single hot red accent for live state and CTAs only
Flat-by-default with subtle card shadows as stateful enhancements
Barlow Condensed display type; Inter for body copy
Pill-shaped buttons for hero CTAs; 12px rounded rectangles for UI

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Scoreboard Red (#c8102e) is used on ≤10% of any given screen's area. It appears only on hero CTAs, live match state, and match outcome badges.

rules.name: The Condensed-Only Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is never used below 0.75rem or in paragraphs. It carries headings and labels; Inter handles all reading text. Never mix them on the same line except for explicit contrast like condensed score numbers.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Text elements, buttons, badges, and inputs never carry shadows. Shadows appear only on card-like containers at rest or in hover state. Depth through transparency (header blur) is the only non-shadow elevation technique.

dos: Do use Barlow Condensed for headings, scores, labels, and nav — never in body copy
Do keep accent red to ≤10% of visible area per screen
Do use rounded-card (12px) for content containers and pill (999px) for badges and hero buttons
Do apply shadows to cards at rest (shadow-card) and on hover (shadow-lift)
Do wrap all page content in .container-content (max-width 72rem)
Do support dark mode via data-theme="dark" or prefers-color-scheme
donts: Don't use multiple accent colors on a single screen
Don't mix font families on the same line for body text
Don't use pure white (#ffffff) as a page background — always surface (ice-50)
Don't apply borders to interactive elements that already have background color treatment
Don't hard-code hex values in components — reference semantic tokens
Don't invent new token names outside the three ramps (navy, red, ice)
